def solve_cvrp(instance):
    depot = instance["depot_index"]
    customers = list(instance["customer_ids"])
    demands = instance["demands"]
    capacity = instance["capacity"]
    D = instance["distance_matrix"]

    # Deterministic customer order: far, high-demand, tie by id
    customers.sort(key=lambda c: (-D[depot][c], -demands[c], c))

    def route_load(route):
        s = 0
        for x in route:
            s += demands[x]
        return s

    def route_cost(route):
        if not route:
            return 0
        cost = D[depot][route[0]]
        for a, b in zip(route, route[1:]):
            cost += D[a][b]
        cost += D[route[-1]][depot]
        return cost

    def best_insertion(route, node):
        if not route:
            return 0, D[depot][node] * 2
        best_pos = 0
        best_delta = D[depot][node] + D[node][route[0]] - D[depot][route[0]]
        for i in range(1, len(route)):
            a = route[i - 1]
            b = route[i]
            delta = D[a][node] + D[node][b] - D[a][b]
            if delta < best_delta or (delta == best_delta and i < best_pos):
                best_delta = delta
                best_pos = i
        tail = D[route[-1]][node] + D[node][depot] - D[route[-1]][depot]
        if tail < best_delta or (tail == best_delta and len(route) < best_pos):
            best_delta = tail
            best_pos = len(route)
        return best_pos, best_delta

    # Initial greedy construction: cheapest feasible insertion into open routes
    routes = []
    loads = []
    for c in customers:
        best_r = -1
        best_pos = 0
        best_delta = None

        for r_idx, route in enumerate(routes):
            if loads[r_idx] + demands[c] > capacity:
                continue
            pos, delta = best_insertion(route, c)
            if best_delta is None or delta < best_delta or (delta == best_delta and (r_idx, pos) < (best_r, best_pos)):
                best_delta = delta
                best_r = r_idx
                best_pos = pos

        # Occasionally starting a new route is better; if no feasible insertion, do so.
        if best_r == -1:
            routes.append([c])
            loads.append(demands[c])
        else:
            routes[best_r].insert(best_pos, c)
            loads[best_r] += demands[c]

    # Merge routes using Clarke-Wright style savings on endpoints
    merged = True
    while merged:
        merged = False
        best = None
        best_gain = 0
        m = len(routes)
        for i in range(m):
            ri = routes[i]
            li = loads[i]
            a0, a1 = ri[0], ri[-1]
            for j in range(i + 1, m):
                rj = routes[j]
                if li + loads[j] > capacity:
                    continue
                b0, b1 = rj[0], rj[-1]

                cand = [
                    (ri + rj, D[depot][a1] + D[depot][b0] - D[a1][b0]),
                    (ri + rj[::-1], D[depot][a1] + D[depot][b1] - D[a1][b1]),
                    (ri[::-1] + rj, D[depot][a0] + D[depot][b0] - D[a0][b0]),
                    (ri[::-1] + rj[::-1], D[depot][a0] + D[depot][b1] - D[a0][b1]),

                        best_gain = gain
                        best = (i, j, merged_route)
        if best is not None and best_gain > 0:
            i, j, new_route = best
            routes[i] = new_route
            loads[i] = route_load(new_route)
            routes.pop(j)
            loads.pop(j)
            merged = True

    # Inter-route relocate improvement
    improved = True
    while improved:
        improved = False
        best_move = None
        best_delta = 0

        loads = [route_load(r) for r in routes]
        for a in range(len(routes)):
            ra = routes[a]
            la = loads[a]
            for idx, node in enumerate(ra):
                prev = depot if idx == 0 else ra[idx - 1]
                nxt = depot if idx == len(ra) - 1 else ra[idx + 1]
                remove_delta = D[prev][nxt] - D[prev][node] - D[node][nxt]

                for b in range(len(routes)):

                        continue
                    rb = routes[b]
                    pos, ins_delta = best_insertion(rb, node)
                    delta = remove_delta + ins_delta
                    if delta < best_delta or (delta == best_delta and best_move is not None and (a, b, idx, pos) < best_move[:4]):
                        best_delta = delta
                        best_move = (a, b, idx, pos, node)

        if best_move is not None and best_delta < 0:
            a, b, idx, pos, node = best_move
            if a < b:
                ra = routes[a]
                rb = routes[b]
                del ra[idx]
                rb.insert(pos, node)
                if not ra:
                    routes.pop(a)
                improved = True
            elif a > b:
                ra = routes[a]
                rb = routes[b]
                del ra[idx]
                rb.insert(pos, node)
                if not ra:
                    routes.pop(a)
                improved = True
            else:
                pass

    # Intra-route 2-opt
    def two_opt(route):
        n = len(route)
        if n < 4:
            return route
        improved = True
        while improved:
            improved = False
            for i in range(n - 2):
                a = depot if i == 0 else route[i - 1]

                        improved = True

        best_move = None
        best_delta = 0

        loads = [route_load(r) for r in routes]
        for a in range(len(routes)):
            ra = routes[a]
            la = loads[a]
            for idx, node in enumerate(ra):
                prev = depot if idx == 0 else ra[idx - 1]
                nxt = depot if idx == len(ra) - 1 else ra[idx + 1]
                remove_delta = D[prev][nxt] - D[prev][node] - D[node][nxt]

                for b in range(len(routes)):
                    if a == b or loads[b] + demands[node] > capacity:
                        continue
                    rb = routes[b]
                    pos, ins_delta = best_insertion(rb, node)
                    delta = remove_delta + ins_delta
                    if delta < best_delta or (delta == best_delta and best_move is not None and (a, b, idx, pos) < best_move[:4]):
                        best_delta = delta
                        best_move = (a, b, idx, pos, node)

        if best_move is not None and best_delta < 0:
            a, b, idx, pos, node = best_move
            if a < b:
                ra = routes[a]
                rb = routes[b]
                del ra[idx]
                rb.insert(pos, node)
                if not ra:
                    routes.pop(a)
                improved = True
            elif a > b:
                ra = routes[a]
                rb = routes[b]
                del ra[idx]
                rb.insert(pos, node)
                if not ra:
                    routes.pop(a)
                improved = True
            else:
                pass

    # Intra-route 2-opt
    def two_opt(route):
        n = len(route)
        if n < 4:
            return route
        improved = True
        while improved:
            improved = False
            for i in range(n - 2):
                a = depot if i == 0 else route[i - 1]
                b = route[i]
                for k in range(i + 2, n):
                    c = route[k - 1]
                    d = depot if k == n else route[k]
                    delta = D[a][c] + D[b][d] - D[a][b] - D[c][d]
                    if delta < 0:
                        route[i:k] = route[i:k][::-1]
                        improved = True
                        break
                if improved:
                    break
        return route

    for i in range(len(routes)):
        routes[i] = two_opt(routes[i])

    # Final cleanup: remove empty routes if any
    routes = [r for r in routes if r]
    return routes
